newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia sells majority stake in fertiliser firm.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia sells majority stake in fertiliser firm.

text.p: Tunisia had sold a majority stake in the country's main fertiliser firm Societe Tunisienne d'Engrais Chimiques STEC as part of its privatisation programme, equities market sources said on Friday.
They told Reuters private Tunisian business group Hamrouni/Doghri bought the 53.76 percent stake for around 7.5 million dinars. The tender was launched last January.
STEC's capital of five million dinars was totally detained by the Tunisian state and its two controlled chemical firms, Groupe Chimique and Compagnie des Phosphates de Gafsa.
STEC markets locally-made and imported fertilisers.
Its turnover in 1995 amounted to 50 million dinars and net profit to 300,000 dinars.
